theorem bestOrder_run (ext : Ext σ) (pid : Nat) (isBuy : Bool) (env : Env) (w : σ) :
    AsyncSwap.bestOrder ext pid isBuy env w =
      let T := tree ext pid isBuy w
      if T.root = 0 then .ok ((false, 0, 0, 0), w)
      else match firstLeaf T isBuy loopBound T.root with
        | none => .error ⟨"loop bound"⟩
        | some c =>
          match ext.fn_AsyncFiller_bestAtPrice_6051 (bookGet ext pid) (bookSet ext pid) isBuy
              (T.nodes c).price env w with
          | .ok (id, w') =>
            .ok ((true, (T.nodes c).price, id, (((ext.get w').asyncOrders pid).orders id).owner), w')
          | .error e => .error e := by
  simp only [AsyncSwap.bestOrder, AsyncMatching.bestOrder, AsyncFiller.bestOrder, run_bind,
    run_pure, run_ite, tree]
  cases isBuy
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false]
    rw [best_run ext (fun w => ((ext.get w).priceBooks pid).asks) _ ?hg]
    case hg => intro env w; rfl
    by_cases h0 : ((ext.get w).priceBooks pid).asks.root = 0
    · simp only [h0, ite_true]; rfl
    · simp only [h0, ite_false]
      cases firstLeaf ((ext.get w).priceBooks pid).asks false loopBound
        ((ext.get w).priceBooks pid).asks.root
      · rfl
      · rename_i c
        simp only [ite_true, run_get]
        cases h : ext.fn_AsyncFiller_bestAtPrice_6051 (bookGet ext pid) (bookSet ext pid) false
            (((ext.get w).priceBooks pid).asks.nodes c).price env w with
        | error e => erw [h]
        | ok p => obtain ⟨id, w'⟩ := p; erw [h]
  · simp only [ite_true]
    rw [best_run ext (fun w => ((ext.get w).priceBooks pid).bids) _ ?hg]
    case hg => intro env w; rfl
    by_cases h0 : ((ext.get w).priceBooks pid).bids.root = 0
    · simp only [h0, ite_true]; rfl
    · simp only [h0, ite_false]
      cases firstLeaf ((ext.get w).priceBooks pid).bids true loopBound
        ((ext.get w).priceBooks pid).bids.root
      · rfl
      · rename_i c
        simp only [ite_true, run_get]
        cases h : ext.fn_AsyncFiller_bestAtPrice_6051 (bookGet ext pid) (bookSet ext pid) true
            (((ext.get w).priceBooks pid).bids.nodes c).price env w with
        | error e => erw [h]
        | ok p => obtain ⟨id, w'⟩ := p; erw [h]

  rw [orderBookOrder_run] at h
  cases h; rfl

theorems.name: recordPriorityFee_run
theorems.text:
theorem recordPriorityFee_run (key : PoolKey) (maker amount : Nat) (env : Env) (w : σ) :
    AsyncSwap.recordPriorityFee ext key maker amount env w =
      let pid := poolId ext key
      let id := pendingId ext w
      let S := (ext.get w).asyncOrders pid
      let info := S.orders id
      if id = 0 ∨ env.sender ≠ pendingExecutor ext w then .error ⟨""⟩
      else if info.owner ≠ maker then .error ⟨""⟩
      else if info.amountIn = 0 ∨ info.priorityFeeEscrowed = true ∨ info.priorityFee ≠ amount
          ∨ amount = 0 then .error ⟨"PriorityFeeNotEscrowed"⟩
      else match ext.call_IPoolManager_mint S.poolManager env.self ext.numeraire amount env w with
        | .ok (_, w1) => afterMint ext pid id w1 env w1
        | .error e => .error e := by
  unfold poolId pendingId pendingExecutor
  simp only [AsyncSwap.recordPriorityFee, AsyncMatching.recordPriorityFee, AsyncFiller.recordPriorityFee,
    PoolIdLibrary.toId, CurrencySettler.take, CurrencyLibrary.toId,
    bind_pure_unit, bind_assoc, pure_bind]
  simp only [run_bind, run_pure, run_read, run_get, run_modify, run_throw, run_ite, ite_true]
  generalize ext.keccak [key.currency0, key.currency1, key.fee,
      toUnsigned 256 key.tickSpacing, key.hooks] = pid
  generalize (ext.get w).transient AsyncSwap.PENDING_MATCH_ID_SLOT = id
  generalize (ext.get w).transient AsyncSwap.PENDING_MATCH_EXECUTOR_SLOT % 2 ^ 160 = ex
  generalize ((ext.get w).asyncOrders pid).orders id = info
  generalize ext.call_IPoolManager_mint _ _ _ _ _ _ = m
  by_cases h1 : id = 0 ∨ env.sender ≠ ex
  · have b1 : (id == 0 || env.sender != ex) = true := by
      rcases h1 with h | h <;> simp [h]
    rw [ite_pos' h1]; simp only [b1, ite_true]
  have b1 : (id == 0 || env.sender != ex) = false := by
    simp only [not_or, Classical.not_not] at h1; simp [h1.1, h1.2]
  rw [ite_neg' h1]; simp only [b1, ite_false, Bool.false_eq_true]
  by_cases h2 : info.owner ≠ maker
  · have b2 : (info.owner != maker) = true := by simp [h2]
    rw [ite_pos' h2]; simp only [b2, ite_true]
  have b2 : (info.owner != maker) = false := by
    simp only [ne_eq, Classical.not_not] at h2; simp [h2]
  rw [ite_neg' h2]; simp only [b2, ite_false, Bool.false_eq_true]
  by_cases hg : info.amountIn = 0 ∨ info.priorityFeeEscrowed = true ∨ info.priorityFee ≠ amount ∨ amount = 0
  · rw [ite_pos' hg]
    cases hA : (info.amountIn == 0) <;> cases hE : info.priorityFeeEscrowed <;>
      cases hF : (info.priorityFee != amount) <;> cases hZ : (amount == 0) <;>
      simp only [Bool.not_true, Bool.not_false, Bool.or_true, Bool.or_false, ite_true, ite_false,
        Bool.false_eq_true] <;>
      first
        | rfl
        | (exfalso; simp only [beq_eq_false_iff_ne, bne_eq_false_iff_eq, ne_eq] at hA hF hZ
           rcases hg with h | h | h | h
           · exact hA h
           · rw [hE] at h; cases h
           · exact h hF
           · exact hZ h)
  · rw [ite_neg' hg]
    simp only [not_or, ne_eq, Classical.not_not, Bool.not_eq_true] at hg
    obtain ⟨ha, he, hf, hz⟩ := hg
    have ba : (info.amountIn == 0) = false := by simp [ha]
    have bf : (info.priorityFee != amount) = false := by simp [hf]
    have bz : (amount == 0) = false := by simp [hz]
    simp only [ba, he, bf, bz, Bool.not_false, Bool.false_or, ite_true, ite_false, Bool.false_eq_true]
    cases m with
    | error e => rfl
    | ok p =>
      obtain ⟨⟨⟩, w1⟩ := p
      simp only [afterMint, flagWorld, selfGet, bookGet, run_bind, beq_iff_eq]
      rfl

theorems.name: recordPriorityFee_unauthorized
theorems.text:
theorem recordPriorityFee_unauthorized (key : PoolKey) (maker amount : Nat) (env : Env) (w : σ)
    (h : pendingId ext w = 0 ∨ env.sender ≠ pendingExecutor ext w) :
    AsyncSwap.recordPriorityFee ext key maker amount env w = .error ⟨""⟩ := by
  rw [recordPriorityFee_run]; simp only; rw [ite_pos' h]

theorems.name: recordPriorityFee_wrong_maker
theorems.text:
theorem recordPriorityFee_wrong_maker (key : PoolKey) (maker amount : Nat) (env : Env) (w : σ)
    (h : (((ext.get w).asyncOrders (poolId ext key)).orders (pendingId ext w)).owner ≠ maker) :
    AsyncSwap.recordPriorityFee ext key maker amount env w = .error ⟨""⟩ := by
  rw [recordPriorityFee_run]; simp only
  by_cases h1 : pendingId ext w = 0 ∨ env.sender ≠ pendingExecutor ext w
  · rw [ite_pos' h1]
  · rw [ite_neg' h1, ite_pos' h]

theorems.name: setOrderingMode_run
theorems.text:
theorem setOrderingMode_run (key : PoolKey) (mode : Nat) (env : Env) (w : σ) :
    AsyncSwap.setOrderingMode ext key mode env w =
      if env.sender ≠ (ext.get w).owner then .error ⟨"NotOwner"⟩
      else if ((ext.get w).priceBooks (setOrderingMode_poolId ext key)).openOrderCount ≠ 0 then
        .error ⟨"InvalidOrderingModeChange"⟩
      else .ok ((), ext.set w { ext.get w with
        priceBooks := upd (ext.get w).priceBooks (setOrderingMode_poolId ext key)
          { (ext.get w).priceBooks (setOrderingMode_poolId ext key) with orderingMode := mode } }) := by
  by_cases h1 : env.sender = (ext.get w).owner <;>
  by_cases h2 : ((ext.get w).priceBooks (setOrderingMode_poolId ext key)).openOrderCount = 0 <;>
  simp_all [AsyncSwap.setOrderingMode, AsyncSwap.onlyOwner, AsyncMatching.setOrderingMode,
    AsyncFiller.setOrderingMode, PoolIdLibrary.toId, setOrderingMode_poolId]

theorems.name: setOrderingMode_notOwner
theorems.text:
theorem setOrderingMode_notOwner (key : PoolKey) (mode : Nat) (env : Env) (w : σ)
    (h : env.sender ≠ (ext.get w).owner) :
    AsyncSwap.setOrderingMode ext key mode env w = .error ⟨"NotOwner"⟩ := by
  rw [setOrderingMode_run]; simp [h]

theorems.name: setOrderingMode_ok_owner
theorems.text:
theorem setOrderingMode_ok_owner (key : PoolKey) (mode : Nat) (env : Env) (w w' : σ)
    (hok : AsyncSwap.setOrderingMode ext key mode env w = .ok ((), w')) :
    env.sender = (ext.get w).owner := by
  by_cases h : env.sender = (ext.get w).owner
  · exact h
  · rw [setOrderingMode_notOwner ext key mode env w h] at hok
    cases hok

theorems.name: sweep_notOwner
theorems.text:
theorem sweep_notOwner (currency to : Nat) (env : Env) (w : σ)
    (h : env.sender ≠ (ext.get w).owner) :
    AsyncSwap.sweep ext currency to env w = .error ⟨"NotOwner"⟩ := by
  unfold AsyncSwap.sweep
  exact onlyOwner_notOwner ext _ env w h

theorems.name: sweep_zeroTo
theorems.text:
theorem sweep_zeroTo (currency : Nat) (env : Env) (w : σ)
    (h : env.sender = (ext.get w).owner) :
    AsyncSwap.sweep ext currency 0 env w = .error ⟨"ZeroAddress"⟩ := by
  unfold AsyncSwap.sweep
  rw [onlyOwner_owner ext _ env w h]
  simp

theorems.name: sweep_reverts_unless
theorems.text:
theorem sweep_reverts_unless (currency to : Nat) (env : Env) (w : σ)
    (h : ¬ (env.sender = (ext.get w).owner ∧ to ≠ 0)) :
    ∃ e, AsyncSwap.sweep ext currency to env w = .error e := by
  by_cases ho : env.sender = (ext.get w).owner
  · have hz : to = 0 := Classical.byContradiction fun hz => h ⟨ho, hz⟩
    subst hz
    exact ⟨_, sweep_zeroTo ext currency env w ho⟩
  · exact ⟨_, sweep_notOwner ext currency to env w ho⟩

theorems.name: transferOwnership_run
theorems.text:
theorem transferOwnership_run (newOwner : Nat) (env : Env) (w : σ) :
    AsyncSwap.transferOwnership ext newOwner env w =
      if env.sender ≠ (ext.get w).owner then .error ⟨"NotOwner"⟩
      else if newOwner = 0 then .error ⟨"ZeroAddress"⟩
      else .ok ((), ext.set w { ext.get w with pendingOwner := newOwner }) := by
  by_cases h1 : env.sender = (ext.get w).owner <;>
  by_cases h2 : newOwner = 0 <;>
  simp [AsyncSwap.transferOwnership, AsyncSwap.onlyOwner, h1, h2]

theorems.name: transferOwnership_notOwner
theorems.text:
theorem transferOwnership_notOwner (newOwner : Nat) (env : Env) (w : σ)
    (h : env.sender ≠ (ext.get w).owner) :
    AsyncSwap.transferOwnership ext newOwner env w = .error ⟨"NotOwner"⟩ := by
  rw [transferOwnership_run]; simp [h]
